messages:
kevin: starting a differential-prefix canary for v9-prefixsafe (int4) on 0.6% traffic. experiment: route by session prefix hash -> some prefixes to quantized path, others to fp16, then compare prefix_preservation_rate and prefix_mismatch_entropy. auto-fallback rules below.

maria: quick context: this model had a known subtle prefix-truncation under the new kv-join; we want a targeted prefix-preservation gate to catch regressions that standard fidelity metrics miss.

kevin: exactly. watch slices: prefix_long (>200 tokens prefix), prefix_cmd (structured instruction prefixes), general_chat. baseline = v9-fp16-prod. gating policy: if prefix_preservation_rate drops by >1.2% absolute or prefix_mismatch_entropy increases by >0.8 bits over baseline in 10m window -> immediate rollback. also add a differential rerank check for prefix reroutes: if rerank_p5 delta >2% relative on prefix_cmd slice, fallback.

sylvie: add a VIP pin for 'prefix-qa' client to keep them on fp16. also enable eval-bot diff dumps when prefix_preservation triggers.

kevin: done. route pins and sample increases: prefix_long n=300, prefix_cmd n=250, general_chat n=200. enabling eval-bot periodic posts every 3m.

kevin: gate config (snippet):
```
gate_id: diff-prefix-4409
canary_fraction: 0.006
route_strategy: prefix_hash
watch_slices: ["prefix_long","prefix_cmd","general_chat"]
metrics: prefix_preservation_rate drop_abs: 1.2% window_s: 600 action: immediate_rollback
         prefix_mismatch_entropy rise_abs: 0.8 window_s: 600 action: immediate_rollback
         rerank_p5 prefix_cmd rel_drop: 2% window_s: 600 action: rollback_after_trigger
autofallback_cooldown_s: 1800
notify: ["#eng-ml","#eng-oncall"]
sample_sizes: default 200, prefix_long=300, prefix_cmd=250
report_interval_s: 180
sample_diffs_on_trigger: true
```

eval-bot: smoke-run started t=0. cohorts: prefix_long(n=300), prefix_cmd(n=250), general_chat(n=200). will post summary every 3m.

maria: add token-prefix-edit logging for prefix_cmd so we can see sub-token shifts; that was key in prior incidents.

sylvie: also enable concordance check for structured command outputs: if exact-match concordance <97% AND prefix_preservation drop >0.8% then immediate rollback.

kevin: updated concordance guard.

eval-bot: t+3m summary: prefix_preservation_rate delta = -0.6% (within threshold), prefix_mismatch_entropy +0.2 bits (ok), rerank_p5 prefix_cmd delta = -0.9% (ok). no triggers.

maria: looks stable so far. keep an eye on any tokenization edgecases in prefix_cmd.

eval-bot: t+9m summary: prefix_preservation_rate delta = -1.4% -> exceeds 1.2% threshold. concordance for prefix_cmd = 96.3% (<97%) -> concordance guard tripped. initiating immediate rollback for v9-prefixsafe. posting 8 sample diffs to secure blob and scaling canary fraction to 0.0. paging #eng-oncall and SRE.

kevin: ack. circuit-breaker applied. pulling diffs and sample edit logs. freezing any auto-promotes for 24h for prefixsafe families.

sylvie: can you dump a couple of diffs inline? even short snippets help triage.

kevin: pasted 3 trimmed diffs: 
- id p-4431: fp16 prefix preserved: "GET /v1/user/12345/profile?fields=name,email" -> int4: "GET /v1/user/12345/profil" (missing "e")
- id p-4477: fp16: "--config:timeout=120s;
apply" -> int4: "--config:timeout=12" (numeric truncation)
- id p-4499: structured cmd exact match failed: phone normalized in fp16 -> int4 inserted country code duplication.

maria: those look like byte-level token cutoffs and numeric token bisections in the quant path. likely quantized softmax rounding interacting with kv-join.

sylvie: action items: 1) revert kv-join optimization in quant path for next build 2) add token-prefix-alignment unit test to CI 3) expand prefix_long offline sim to n=10k and run a calibration sweep on head softmax scale.

kevin: opening PRs and tickets now (ML-6001 for revert, ML-6002 for token-prefix-tests, ML-6003 for calibration). scheduling 40m triage.

eval-bot: diffs uploaded to secure store (link).

sre-bot: SRE notified. if rollback reoccurs within 30m, page on-call. monitoring updated.

maria: also propose adding a new metric to gating: numeric_token_integrity_rate for future runs to catch timeout/number truncations.

kevin: good idea. adding to backlog and will include in next smoke run config.

sylvie: summary: differential-prefix canary rolled back due to prefix_preservation drop -1.4% and concordance <97% on prefix_cmd. circuit-breaker applied, diffs captured, VIP pinned, follow-ups assigned. thanks team :folded_hands:
